Scope: Byte-exact original local evidence: original failures and passes, source/output observations, review and targeted resolutions, caller injection tests, actual initialization smoke and owned database cleanup. Counts do not imply combined execution or complete business acceptance.
Excluded: Credentials/ownership receipt contents, private cursor state/Data Protection keys and raw application stdout/stderr. App reports retain their local-only log hashes; these logs are not archived.
Limits: Historical RED stubs have recorded source hashes only, not preserved stub source bytes. Source/output observations are not complete compiler manifests. Forced ORD timeout path was statically reviewed; normal ORD concurrency was rerun. Caller exception tests inject failures and are not native DB business acceptance. Native reports include prerequisite checks and preserve original scope.
